display_name: Apnea-Hypopnea Index (REM): (Apneas with >= 2% oxygen desaturation and with or without arousal + hypopneas with > 30% flow reduction and >= 2% oxygen desaturation and with or without arousal) / hour of REM sleep from type I polysomnography
description: Calculated - RDI in REM sleep (>= 2% desaturation)
calculation: 60*(hrembp2 + hrop2 + carbp2 + carop2 + oarbp2 + oarop2 + marbp2 + marop2) / minremp
